text: He keeps forgetting names and repeats the same question. He sleeps badly at night. Cooking has become hard for him and I help with bills now.
She said she wants to die last night and has not been eating. I do not know what to do. She forgets my name sometimes and gets angry.
Dad fell yesterday and hit his head on the table, he seemed sleepy afterwards. He also forgets to take tablets and repeats questions often.
He got lost near the park and a neighbour brought him back. Memory is worse in the evenings and he is angry and suspicious of us often.
Maybe she took her tablets twice, I am not sure. Her sleep is poor and she seems low in mood and forgets things she was told.
Mom is fine mostly, forgets where she keeps glasses and repeats stories sometimes, but enjoys cooking and manages her bills and shopping well.
खो गए थे बाज़ार में, पड़ोसी घर छोड़ गए। दवा दो बार दे दी शायद।
He suddenly became confused and his speech was slurred this morning. He has also been forgetting recent events for months.
